title: Predicting Effects, Missing Distributions: Evaluating LLMs as Human Behavior Simulators in Operations Management

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating human subjects in operations management lab experiments (e.g., inventory management, auctions, supply chain, and forecasting) using zero-shot and chain-of-thought prompting, and comparing the LLM outputs to human data using hypothesis-testing replication and Wasserstein distance to measure distributional alignment.
